description: Fork of exp343 (soft-forward variant of exp336). T=0.5 fixed throughout training (T_start=T_end=0.5; the anneal scheduler still runs but stays at constant T). Matches exp336's TinyMHLut soft-mode operating temperature (select_temp=0.5). Tests whether SoftMultiHeadLUT(hard=False) at T=0.5 trains better, same, or worse than TinyMHLut(hard forward + soft backward) at T=0.5 (= exp336 = 1.6475). exp343 showed T_start=5.0 was way too soft (model couldn't discriminate rows).
